item.title: LETTER: GGE & 110 Organizations Demand The Cancellation Of Plans To Hire 475 New School Cops
item.description: With Communities United for Police Reform and dozens of community partners, GGE co-signed a letter to the Mayor and Police Commissioner to stop the proposed funding of 475 new school cops.

item.title: LETTER TO THE EDITOR: We’re Serious When We Demand Police-Free Schools
item.description: In response to an article by the New York Daily News Editorial Board, GGE authored a letter to the editor outlining the strength behind the Police-Free Schools demand.
